entries.name: openRecoveryStore
entries.authority: Node24.16.0/local supported filesystem, explicit installationId/lineageId/Scope and capture/Types; owner handle not principal-facing
entries.actions: SQLite recovery, synchronous owner reads, admissions/member commits/release/expiry/close
notActions: certification of partial or coherent full-store rollback

entries.name: openTransactionStore
entries.authority: exclusive SQLite owner, exact config/contracts/types and persisted authorization; new epoch minted only on create, existing epoch loaded on reopen
entries.applicability: No inference from raw SQL edits or freshcreate to a supported restore; returns source-private owner only

entries.name: replaceAuthorizationPolicy
entries.authority: private handle calls service policy drain/publication; store only supports all-visible generation0→empty generation1 policy
entries.actions: authorization revocation/view rotation; not content destruction or epoch change
entries.applicability: Withheld ≠ erased. Policy transition cannot substitute for erasure ledger or cleanup; final multi-view admin policy unknown

entries.name: offline SQL mutation / test fault hooks

entries.name: copied hot SQLite image test
